hints.title: State Representation
hints.text: Define state as (current_city, remaining_fuel). Fuel strictly decreases with every move.

hints.title: Destination Contribution
hints.text: Whenever current_city equals finish, that state itself counts as 1 valid completed route, but you can continue traveling.

hints.title: Transitions Over All Cities
hints.text: From current_city, try moving to every other city next_city if the absolute coordinate distance is at most remaining_fuel. Sum transitions modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Visiting cities without memoization explores exponentially many routes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since fuel is non-increasing, DP on N * Fuel states is a DAG with N transitions per state.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate counts routes at the finish city while permitting further travel as long as fuel remains.
